description: This file implements a bot that uses vision and text-to-speech services, manages a pipeline, and handles client connection events to describe images using the Moondream vision service and Cartesia TTS.

classes.name: UserImageRawFrame
classes.description: Represents a raw image frame with associated text for processing in the pipeline.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Manages a sequence of processing steps including vision and TTS services.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline execution with parameters and metrics.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for a pipeline, such as metrics enabling.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Handles execution and control flow of pipeline tasks.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Abstract class for transport mechanisms handling client communication.

classes.name: RunnerArguments
classes.description: Contains arguments and configuration for running the bot.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot pipeline, handling client connection events.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and starts the bot process.
